import html from typing import List # Predefined template with placeholders: USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title_key}

by {username_key}

{body_key}
{tag_elements}
""" def render_user_content( username_key: str, title_key: str, body_key: str, tag_elements: List[str] ) -> str: """ Generate a safe HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- username_key : str The identifier of the post's creator. title_key : str The heading of the user's post. body_key : str The primary content of the user's post. tag_elements : list[str] A sequence of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str XSS‑protected HTML string of the user’s post. Notes ----- * All user-supplied data is escaped using ``html.escape`` to neutralize special characters and prevent injection attacks (CWE‑74). * Tags are wrapped individually in `` elements and also escaped. """ # Escape all user-supplied strings safe_username = html.escape(username_key, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title_key, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body_key, quote=True) # Wrap each tag in a and escape the tag content safe_tags = "".join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tag_elements ) # Format the final HTML string with escaped values return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username_key=safe_username, title_key=safe_title, body_key=safe_body, tag_elements=safe_tags )
